name: svg-viewer
displayName: SVG Viewer & SVG Preview (Zoom, PNG Export)
description: SVG viewer and SVG preview for VS Code: live preview beside the editor, zoom at the cursor and pan, viewBox outline, checkerboard or custom background, sprite sheet grid for <symbol>, .svgz, and PNG export at 1x to 8x. Scripts never run. Free, offline.

editor/title.when: resourceExtname =~ /^\.svgz?$/i && activeCustomEditorId != svgViewer.editor && activeCustomEditorId != svgViewer.svgz && activeWebviewPanelId != svgViewer.preview

svgViewer.preview.autoOpen.description: Open the preview beside the editor by itself when you open an .svg file as text.

enumDescriptions: A light checkerboard, so transparent areas show.
The editor background of the current theme.
svgViewer.defaultBackground.description: Background behind the picture until you pick one in the toolbar. Your toolbar choice is kept for each workspace.

enumDescriptions: The wheel zooms at the pointer. Shift + wheel pans.
The wheel pans. Ctrl or Cmd + wheel, or a pinch, zooms.
svgViewer.mouseWheel.description: What the mouse wheel does in the picture. Dragging always pans, and a trackpad pinch always zooms.

svgViewer.maxFileMB.description: Files larger than this show their size and the first lines of facts first, and draw when you click Render it.

svgViewer.askForRating.description: Ask at most two times for a Marketplace rating, after you have opened a few SVG files on different days. Nothing is sent anywhere.

svgViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in the status line of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with SVG Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Preview SVG files beside the editor, zoom into details and export PNGs.

steps.title: Open the preview beside the editor
steps.description:
Open an .svg file and click the preview button in the editor title, or press Cmd+K V (Ctrl+K V). The preview follows your edits before you save.
[Find an SVG file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.svg%22%5D)

media.altText: A world map SVG open in SVG Viewer beside its source, zoomed into Europe.

steps.title: Zoom, pan and check the viewBox
steps.description: Scroll to zoom at the pointer and drag to pan, at any zoom. Fit (0) and 1:1 (1) reset the view. viewBox (V) outlines the viewBox and dims what lies outside it.

steps.title: Export PNG and copy
steps.description: Pick 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x or a width, then Save PNG or Copy PNG. Copy data URI puts the SVG on the clipboard as a data: URI for CSS or HTML.

steps.title: Background, wheel and size limit
steps.description:
Pick the default background, what the mouse wheel does, and the size above which a file asks before it draws.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22svgViewer%22%5D)
